Ravi (AE): Heads-up team: MedBridge Labs POC request landed. Use case = discharge-note condensing + flagging high-risk follow-ups for care coordinators. They want a compact runbook and concrete KPI targets to sign off quickly.

Ravi (AE): POC ask: 10-business-day trial. Traffic sim ~250k tokens/day, avg input ~420 tokens, expected output ~60 tokens. Concurrent bursts to 30rps.

Ravi (AE): Proposed acceptance (customer): p95 latency <= 180ms (in-region), precision >= 0.91 for high-risk tags, ROUGE-L >= 0.46 for summaries, total infra spend <= $900/day at target load. Need two consecutive business days of passing metrics + reproducible eval artifacts.

Nora (PSE): Quick check: are they OK with initial hosted deployment? Any compliance constraints (PHI/KMS)?

Ravi (AE): Hosted is preferred for speed. They do want audit logs + KMS for keying but said VPC is optional for the trial. We can use de-identified data for bench runs.

Lena (ML Eng): For the ROUGE + precision targets, do we have a gold set size? Also, sequence distribution matters — 420 tokens in + 60 out influences KV cache behavior.

Ravi (AE): Gold set = 3k holdout notes, labeled for risk tags. I'll share S3 link after NDA.

Lena (ML Eng): Plan: sweep redwood-7b, redwood-13b-q, and 30b-qat on dedicated test-pool. Run latency + quality suite. My hypothesis: 7b might hit ROUGE but miss precision; 13b-q likely best cost/quality trade.

Lena (ML Eng): Quick pseudo-run:

Lena (ML Eng): ```
for model in [redwood-7b, redwood-13b-q, redwood-30b-qat]:
  run_eval(model, split='3k_gold')
  collect_latency(model, concurrency=[1,5,15,30])
```

Lena (ML Eng): Need API key + access to the gold set to start benchmarks tomorrow.

Omar (SRE): p95 180ms at 30rps is aggressive on shared hosted. Options: set soft SLO for hosted and hard SLO for Dedicated, or require a tiny dedicated pool for the POC. Also plan fallback routing: primary=13b-q, fallback=7b with downgraded summary length.

Priya (Ops): Ops constraints: KMS onboarding ~48 hours (assuming standard legal), audit-log retention for POC = 30 days (customer asked). VPC peering incl. security review ~6 business days if requested. For the POC we can do hosted + KMS.

Nora (PSE): Ballpark cost estimate (hosted): 13b-q ~= $0.00085/token -> at 250k tokens/day ~ $213/day. Add infra multiplier for concurrency & features ~2x -> $425/day. With KMS/audit -> +$75/day -> ~ $500/day. Dedicated reserve numbers will change.

infra-bot: Test pool provision starting: pool-id pb-nyc-77. Status: initializing (1/3). Logs: https://ci.redwood/p/pb-nyc-77/logs :gear: 

Omar (SRE): I'll propose autoscale curve: target CPU headroom 30%, max scale to handle 40rps burst, cooldown 45s. Also adding rate-limiter with 429-based fallback and model-routing rule.

Lena (ML Eng): For acceptance script I'll produce: (1) run_eval.sh that generates metrics.csv, (2) run_latency.sh that outputs p95.json, (3) acceptance.sh that asserts thresholds and zips logs.

Ravi (AE): Open sign-off items:
- A1: Confirm models to benchmark (Lena)
- A2: Hosted vs small dedicated POC recommendation + cost write-up (Nora + Omar)
- A3: KMS + audit checklist + estimated lead times (Priya)
- A4: Eval harness + acceptance scripts (Lena)
- A5: Runbook + fallback policy for production ramp (Omar)

Priya (Ops): I'll start KMS paperwork + audit retention config today. Will flag any legal block in 24h.

Nora (PSE): Will send hosted vs dedicated one-pager and commit-level example for Dedicated by EOD.

Lena (ML Eng): I'll kick off benchmarks once I get the key + gold set. Expect initial numbers in 36 hours.

Omar (SRE): Posting fallback routing draft in the next hour. Recommend we relax hosted p95 to 220ms soft for POC and keep 180ms for Dedicated.

Ravi (AE): Great, plan to start Monday. Mid-POC check Thursday morning. Once A1-A4 are done I'll send the acceptance checklist to the customer for signature. :thumbsup: 

Ravi (AE): (internal note) Thread for docs: "MedBridge POC - discharge condense + risk flags: KPIs & runbook" (not a Slack title).
